name: Nag Hammadi

requests.outcome: Official ESA page describes the national urban real-estate register GIS program, its participating agencies, and limited implementation history. It exposes no Nag Hammadi parcel viewer, feature API, schema, CRS, or geometry response.

Official ESA service catalog lists paper maps, digital maps, historical maps, coordinate certificates, boundary separation, and related surveying services. It is a service catalog, not an anonymous parcel-feature endpoint.

Current public HTML is an ASP.NET city-map catalog with province/center/district selectors. The exposed options and page scripts did not provide Nag Hammadi parcel geometry or a public map/API configuration.
Current public HTML is an ASP.NET paper-map search form with scale/map-name selectors. No parcel feature response, stable native parcel ID schema, or CRS payload was exposed.

Official Egyptian Gazette/Justice notice identifies cadastral survey sections under Nag Hammadi center and a real-estate-register procedure/effective-date postponement. This establishes local cadastral/procedure evidence, not a public geometry service.
Official Gazette PDF mirror returns the same type of Nag Hammadi cadastral-section/effective-date evidence. No machine-readable parcel layer or anonymous feature endpoint was exposed.

viewerInspection.details: No official Nag Hammadi parcel viewer URL, current viewer JavaScript/configuration, public map service URL, or anonymous parcel API was identified. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, or unsafe registry fields were attempted.

schemaCrs.details: No parcel-feature response was obtained; native field names, stable parcel identity, geometry encoding, and CRS could not be verified.

scopeLimits: The official legal notice and ESA catalog evidence a cadastral custodian/procedure and map services, but not an open Nag Hammadi parcel layer.
Catalog selector absence or lack of an API is a public-service availability limitation, not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
The exact WUP point was preserved and no exact-point parcel query was issued because no public parcel endpoint was discovered.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, transaction, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No raw source attribute sets or GeoJSON were retained; no stable native parcel ID plus full safe polygon was available.
uncertainty: High: official local cadastral/procedural coverage is evidenced, but public digital parcel access, schema, CRS, and geometry availability remain unknown. Independent serial review is required before any adapter or source admission.
